lines.text: 边界：Defect Signature 通常不是唯一解；必须用时序、空间分布和独立量测建立证据链。
lines.zh: 边界：Defect Signature 通常不是唯一解；必须用时序、空间分布和独立量测建立证据链。
lines.en: Boundary: a Defect Signature usually has no unique explanation; build an evidence chain using time sequence, spatial distribution and independent metrology.
